operations.name: ai.generate
operations.description: Run one prompt through the host's language model and return the raw text (empty string when no language model is connected).

operations.name: integrations.status
operations.description: Whether a language model is connected (CraftBot's bridge or a running framework bridge), so the screen can show an honest LLM-available banner.

operations.name: sessions.list
operations.description: Your improvement sessions, newest first: id, title, status, mode, tone and variant count, as the sidebar lists them.

operations.name: sessions.get
operations.description: One session as the merge view shows it: numbered conflicts with their choices (original, A, B...), additions, picks left, and the compiled…

operations.name: sessions.result
operations.description: The compiled result: the final text (what Copy copies), the word diff against the original, words added and removed.

operations.name: sessions.create
operations.description: Start a session: the text, a mode and 2-5 variants; the LLM writes the variants, which can take minutes.

text.description: The text to improve; separate paragraphs with a blank line

instruction.description: Required with mode custom: the free-form instruction

operations.name: sessions.regenerate
operations.description: Ask the LLM for fresh variants of a session; replaces every pick and the compiled result.

operations.name: sessions.pick
operations.description: Pick a version for a conflict (original, A-E, or none to unpick) or include/skip an addition; the compiled text updates.

choice.description: Conflict: original, A-E or none. Addition: include or skip
